_comment: Real props from Final Assembly execution 598 (project 'A man and a woman
talking about equality', 9:16, Emotional, 41.8s, one chapter card at 7.7s).
Captured so `npm run studio` opens on a genuine project with real scene
timings instead of invented ones. Fields n8n does not send (palette,
outro/hook durations, subscribeText) fall back to defaultFinalVideoProps.
Two deliberate changes from what that render actually used: showHookTitle
and showChapterCards were false there, and are true here — they are the
overlays worth looking at. Flip them back in the props panel to see the
finalVideoUrl is empty on purpose, so this always works. The assembled
video lives at the render server's /output, which Railway wipes on
redeploy — pointing here at one meant the fixture broke within a day and
took the whole preview down with it. Empty renders PreviewBackdrop
instead: moving picture with shadow, midtone and highlight, which is what
judging typography and the light leak actually needs.
To preview over real footage, drop an mp4 into remotion/public/ and set
finalVideoUrl to '/<filename>.mp4' — a relative URL resolves against the
Studio server, same as staticFile(). Any video works; it does not have to

scenes.narratorText: Daniel's jacket pocket holds the pay stub, creased and ready. Maya’s notebook waits, pages filled.
I brought this home again. Look—overtime, three extra nights.
The bills are on the fridge, Maya. I keep pointing at the same proof.
Then look here. I wrote the daycare calls, your mother’s appointments, the hours I miss, the smaller check. Don’t make my work disappear because it isn’t printed.
On the roof, he stops reaching for the stub, slides it into her notebook,
and stands beside her until their joined reflection in the rooftop glass turns equality from a debate into a shared burden they will both name honestly.
